context.transcript:
Good morning, this is Westlake Medical Clinic.
How can I help you?
Hi, this is Jason Kim.
I just received a letter from you explaining that Dr. Patel is retiring in March, but I already had an appointment scheduled with him for April.
Is there another doctor being assigned to his patients?
Well, we've assigned another doctor to you, but you also have the option to choose someone else at our clinic.
You can find a full biography for each one of our doctors on our website to help you make your choice.
Oh, okay.
Then I think I'll take a look at the biographies on the site before I decide.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好，这里是 Westlake 诊所。
我能帮您什么？
嗨，我是 Jason Kim。
我刚收到您的信，解释说 Patel 医生将在三月退休，但我已经和他在四月预约了。
是否为他的病人安排了其他医生接手？
嗯，我们为您安排了另一位医生，但您也可以选择诊所里的其他人。
您可以在我们的网站上找到每位医生的完整简介，帮助您做出选择。
哦，好的。
那我想我会在决定之前先看看网站上的这些简介。
谢谢。
